About the Prepared Speaking event

Prepared Speaking is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Prepared Speaking solo event (middle school, secondary and postsecondary), built around the 2026–27 topic “Redefine the Standard” and the 105-point rating sheet (content 60, organization 30, delivery 15): interpreting the theme, choosing a point of view, gathering credible support, writing a powerful opening, a cohesive body and an impactful closing, writing for the ear, delivering a five-minute speech without a microphone and rehearsing with rubric-based feedback. Includes pattern, transition, timing and filler-reduction drills and practice scenarios.
